connect_realtime_session: create a RealtimeSession with api_key, model, voice, and instructions then call connect to open the WebSocket
speak_text_to_audio: call speak on a connected RealtimeSession to send text and write decoded PCM audio to the sink file
close_realtime_session: call close on a RealtimeSession to cleanly disconnect the WebSocket; safe to call multiple times
run_realtime_speaker_from_queue: create a RealtimeSpeaker with a session and JSONL queue path then run run_until_stopped with a stop function
test_with_fake_websocket: use the FakeWS class to script WebSocket recv frames and inspect sent frames during testing
